SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.date_range, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'reg' THEN count ELSE 0 END) as regCount, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'del' THEN count ELSE 0 END) as delCount FROM ( SELECT DATE(register_time) as date_range, COUNT(*) as count, 'reg' as type FROM tb_ai_user WHERE register_time >= #{start} GROUP BY date_range UNION ALL SELECT DATE(cancel_time) as date_range, COUNT(*) as count, 'del' as type FROM tb_ai_user WHERE cancel_time >= #{start} GROUP BY date_range ) t GROUP BY date_range ORDER BY date_range ASC
SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(email, '@', -1) as name, COUNT(*) as value FROM tb_ai_user GROUP BY name ORDER BY value DESC
